dct_description_sm: Through the ACP Grant, NSWA commissioned TetraTech to complete the repeatable Sturgeon River Water Quality Monitoring Program along the main stem and tributaries from 2021 - 2022. Four sampling events were conducted, one in spring (April/May) and another in summer (August/September) of each of 2021 and 2022. The purpose of the program is to extend the baseline database and identify issues and eventually be able to detect trends in water quality over time.
dct_title_s: Sturgeon River Water Quality Monitoring Program
